rule.definition: model at the mean operating point of the input; the power of the task is its window mean plus one sinusoid, allocated to the halls by the allocation column of the task; amplitude sqrt(2) times the standard deviation of the task power over the window, so the sinusoid has the RMS of the task fluctuation; applied through the in-device oscillators, no sampled profile
rule.frequency: the highest grid frequency f* such that the gain of F from the task to the PCC active power stays within 2% of its value at 0.1 Hz at EVERY grid frequency up to f*
rule.fixed_from: the saved response of F alone, before any equivalent is built

offpeak_control.written: after the phase F of P2 and before any grouping or equivalent of P2
